persistence.model: Persist immutable job metadata and derive stage progression/result on read.

resultRouteBehavior.initialLoad: Server-loads the current snapshot by job id.
resultRouteBehavior.polling: Client polls /api/jobs/:jobId every 1s until terminal state.
resultRouteBehavior.completionSwap: Renders the existing workbench once result is present.

nextBatchRecommended: Replace fixture-key selection with a real crawl/extract orchestration layer while preserving the same job route contract.
Introduce richer failed-job states and explicit retry semantics instead of only happy-path progression.
Move from time-derived mock results to evidence-backed partition generation without changing the one-main-DESIGN.md policy.
Generate real content for each export tab and add result-specific verification beyond placeholder readiness.
